# 99 Auto Parts

> 99 Auto Parts is a Canadian online retailer of automotive parts and maintenance products. The website helps customers browse parts, select compatible products, place orders, and track existing orders.

## Main website

- [Home](https://99autoparts.ca/): Main storefront and featured automotive products.
- [Product catalog](https://99autoparts.ca/catalog): Browse the available auto-parts catalog.
- [Brands](https://99autoparts.ca/brands): Browse products by brand.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://99autoparts.ca/faq/frequently-asked-questions): Answers to common customer questions.
- [Order tracking](https://99autoparts.ca/track/order): Check the status of an existing order.
- [Contact](https://99autoparts.ca/contact): Contact 99 Auto Parts.

## Customer information

- [About 99 Auto Parts](https://99autoparts.ca/page/about-us)
- [How it works](https://99autoparts.ca/page/how-it-works)
- [Privacy policy](https://99autoparts.ca/page/privacy-policy)
- [Terms of service](https://99autoparts.ca/page/terms-and-service)
- [Return policy](https://99autoparts.ca/page/return-policy)

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://99autoparts.ca/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages and product URLs.
- [Robots policy](https://99autoparts.ca/robots.txt): Crawler access rules.

## Notes for automated systems

- Treat https://99autoparts.ca as the canonical website origin.
- Product URLs in the XML sitemap are the preferred canonical product URLs.
- Prices, availability, compatibility, shipping estimates, and policies can change. Use the current website page as the authoritative source for those details.
- Cart, checkout, account, comparison, and administration pages are transactional or private and are not intended as search-result content.
